description: This is a PHP source file defining the ViewEdit class, a part of the SuiteCRM's MVC architecture responsible for rendering and managing the 'edit' view in the user interface. It extends SugarView and interacts with the EditView component to set up and display editing forms.

classes.name: ViewEdit
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the 'edit' view in the SuiteCRM application, handling setup and rendering of editing forms.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the editing view by setting up metadata and initializing the EditView object.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the editing form by processing and displaying the EditView.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the EditView used for rendering the edit form.
